metadata.title: रोज़ केरकेट्टा: जंगल की आवाज़ हमेशा के लिए खामोश | Dr. Rose Kerketta: Voice of Adivasi Identity
metadata.description: Dr. Rose Kerketta, the powerful voice of tribal identity, literature, and women's rights, passed away on 17th April 2025. This video is a heartfelt tribute to her life, her work, and her legacy. She was not just a writer — she was a movement.
